messages: lucy: did a quick keyboard/navigation pass on the topology panel updates. found three things: 1) focus ring on compact list items disappears when the row is selected, 2) arrow-key navigation between inline chips is inconsistent, 3) updates to the status pill aren't announced to screen readers. attaching small vid: https://assets.redwood/a11y/topology-nav.mp4 :mag_right: omar: thanks. for 1) do you mean the focus outline goes away or it's visually identical to selection styles? lucy: it becomes identical to the selected state: both use a 1px subtle border. keyboard users can't tell focus from selection. on dark theme that looks like no focus. kelly: we should follow the pattern: selection state vs keyboard focus are distinct. focus must be visible even when selected. proposal: add a high-contrast ring on :focus-visible and keep selection as a filled bg. e.g. ``` .item.selected { background: var(--muted-500); } .item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-500); outline-offset: 3px; } .item.selected:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(96,165,250,0.16); } ``` that keeps focus strong without removing selection semantics. omar: sounds good. prefer :focus-visible to avoid mouse noise. check contrast: on dark theme our focus color must meet 3:1 against selected bg. kelly, can you run quick contrast? kelly: yes i'll test. for 2) arrow navigation between chips: sometimes left/right moves between chips, sometimes it moves the entire list (depends whether chip is a button or anchor). inconsistent HTML causes AT to alternate behavior. unify chips to "
